title: Automatic Plant Watering and Tracking System
abstract: Many people struggle with watering their plants regularly, which usually leads to plants becoming unhealthy or dying. To address this common issue, it is important to monitor basic factors such as soil moisture and temperature in order to determine the proper time and amount of water needed. Since manual watering is not always consistent or reliable, this automatic plant watering system is designed to assist gardeners by providing an accurate irrigation based on real time weather conditions and the specific water requirements of each plant. The system includes a monitoring mechanism that helps ensure proper and efficient water usage, reducing water waste and supporting healthy plant growth. Additionally, the application includes a built-in encyclopedia that offers detailed information about a variety of plant types, helping users to understand their plant’s water needs, caring details and other useful facts. This solution makes it easier to take care for plants, especially when they are located away from owners.

title: نَبْت A Machine Learning-Based Plant Recommendation System for Urban Sustainability in Riyadh
abstract: Urban greening has become increasingly important, especially in Saudi Arabia, where Vision 2030 emphasizes sustainability and environmental well-being. This project focuses on developing a machine-learning-based plant recommendation system tailored to Riyadh's unique climate, using machine learning models such as K-nearest neighbor (KNN) and K-means. The system analyzes inputs such as spread, humidity, irrigation, maintenance, plant type and salinity to recommend suitable plant types, supporting initiatives like the Green Riyadh project. By combining urban planning with advanced technologies, the system aims to assist decision-makers in selecting plants that thrive in specific conditions, thereby contributing to the creation of sustainable and livable urban spaces. The project addresses challenges like limited data and scalability. It offers a user-friendly dashboard for recommendations and plant tracking. This innovative approach aligns with Vision 2030’s goals and represents a step toward smarter urban planning.

title: AI-Powered Platform for Plant Identification and Diagnosis
abstract: LeafNet is an innovative web application utilizing AI to provide comprehensive plant health solutions. Leveraging deep learning, it diagnoses plant diseases from uploaded images and features an AI chatbot expert for plant care inquiries. This project addresses accurate disease identification and expert guidance, integrating image processing, machine learning, and conversational AI. This report details LeafNet's design, functionality, architecture, implementation, testing plan, evaluation, and final results. LeafNet offers a dynamic resource for plant lovers, empowering informed decisions and contributing to sustainable plant care.

title: SyncUp
abstract: Remote teamwork has revolutionized project implementation, offering a flexible and collaborative solution to modern workplace demands. However, the abundance of scattered applications for meetings, task management, and communication often cause inefficiencies and distraction. To address these challenges, we propose SyncUp, a unified platform that enables seamless project management and real-time collaboration. SyncUp allows users to create and manage projects, edit shared files collaboratively, leave notes, and track progress using intuitive visual indicators that highlight remaining time and tasks. Additionally, users can seek expert advice when needed, fostering a community-driven approach to problem-solving. The platform's design incorporates agile methodologies, ensuring iterative improvements based on user feedback and evaluations. By integrating these features, SyncUp aims to streamline remote teamwork, enhance productivity, and promote effective collaboration.

title: Driver drowsiness detection system
abstract: Drowsy driving is one of the major causes of road accidents, especially on long highways and during night travel. Many drivers are unaware that they are sleepy until it is too late. This project aims to solve that problem by developing a real-time drowsiness detection system using a smart camera (Nicla Vision) and a lightweight AI model. The system monitors the driver’s face and checks if their eyes are closed. If the eyes stay closed for more than three seconds, a buzzer sounds to alert the driver. We trained a custom machine learning model using images of eyes labeled as “Drowsy” and “Not Drowsy” through Edge Impulse. The model was then deployed to the Nicla Vision board, allowing it to run completely offline and in real time. The use of a small embedded device ensures low cost, energy efficiency, and easy installation in any vehicle. The prototype was tested under controlled conditions and successfully detected signs of drowsiness with 95% accuracy. This solution is practical, affordable. It highlights how AI and embedded systems can improve public safety. By alerting drowsy drivers early, the system helps reduce accident risks and contributes to building safer roads.

title: Collab: A Revolutionary web-based platform designed for collaborative coding projects
abstract: Collab is a web-based platform developed to transform collaborative coding by addressing key challenges such as poor communication, version control issues, and fragmented workflows. It provides two core features that enhance productivity and teamwork. The first is real-time simultaneous coding, which allows multiple users to write, review, and edit code together in a shared environment. The second is integrated project management, offering drag-and-drop UML diagramming, task distribution, and progress tracking tools—all within the same workspace. Designed especially for academic and educational settings, Collab streamlines the collaborative process by combining technical development with visual project planning. Its intuitive interface supports various programming languages and tools, ensuring accessibility for students, instructors, and development teams alike. With full browser-based access and support for remote collaboration, Collab is built for modern, global use. It empowers users to manage projects efficiently, foster innovation, and improve outcomes in coding-based coursework, capstone projects, and real-world software development practice.

title: عَون AWN Volunteer management website
abstract: Volunteering is the act of individuals offering their time, skills, and resources to benefit others without financial compensation, enhancing the cohesion and progress of society. To support this field, we are developing an intermediary website that connects volunteer organizations with volunteers, making it easier for them to collaborate effectively. Our website simplifies volunteer program management by helping volunteers or guests track attendance, record and calculate volunteer hours, and view detailed program plans. Supervisors can assign specific tasks and responsibilities, while progress reports are automatically sent to all parties involved to ensure transparency and accountability. Additionally, certificates are automatically issued to volunteers, personalized with their names and achievements, and electronically signed by the supervisor. This solution will streamline the volunteer experience, making it more efficient and rewarding for both volunteers and organizations.

title: AutoReview
abstract: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) currently relies on domain experts to manually review Summaries of Product Characteristics (SPCs) submitted by pharmaceutical companies. Manual comparisons between generic drugs and registered New Chemical Entities (NCEs) are time-consuming and prone to human error, potentially impacting the efficiency and reliability of regulatory decisions. This project present AutoReview, an AI-based system proposed to completely automate the SPC review process to alleviate these issues. The proposed system leverages transformer-based models in the automatic documentation of contextual comparison and data extraction. Our approach uses cosine similarity to calculate the semantic similarity between sections of the SPC. To improve transparency and interpretability, AutoReview utilizes the thresholds based highlighting approach aimed at greater transparency and interpretability, producing color-coded results that clearly mark sections as either compatible or incompatible. The framework acts in alignment with principles of explainable information retrieval. Reviewed by experts, AutoReview aims to outperform existing solutions in maintaining internal consistency, increasing automated workflows, and rationalizing regulatory analysis.

title: PNU ChatBot
abstract: The “PNU ChatBot” project aims to help students easily access academic information through a web-based chatbot. Using natural language processing (NLP), it provides 24/7 instant responses to common questions about programs and services, improving student engagement and self reliance. The chatbot is developed through stakeholder input and undergoes design, testing, and deployment on the web, with feedback gathered for continuous improvement.

title: A Near Real-Time Phishing Website Detection Tool Using a Hybrid Model of Deep Learning Algorithms
abstract: Phishing attacks represent a major cybersecurity threat, as they deceive users into disclosing sensitive information through websites that mimic legitimate ones. The increasing complexity of phishing techniques, along with limited user awareness, makes timely detection a persistent challenge, despite significant advances in security technologies. To address this issue, we present “لصَن”, a smart and efficient browser-based tool for near real-time phishing website detection. The system is powered by a custom-built hybrid deep learning modeldeveloped entirely by our team—that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long ShortTerm Memory (LSTM) architectures. Our approach analyzes both URLs and webpage content, enabling more accurate and reliable detection. We designed and trained the hybrid model using a self-constructed dataset of 23,068 samples, evenly divided between 11,534 phishing and 11,534 legitimate websites. Each sample includes 24 distinct features, carefully extracted from both the URL structure and the HTML content of the page. Our hybrid model achieved an impressive accuracy of 97.79%, highlighting its effectiveness in detecting phishing website threats. By integrating the hybrid model into a browser extension, “لصَن” provides users with near real-time protection and promotes safer browsing behavior.

title: Fileless Malware Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: With the emergence of new fileless malware attacks that cannot be detected by conventional methods of anti-malware detection techniques, the cost of such attacks increases every day. The concept behind creating fileless malware attacks allows them to bypass traditional methods of detection and blocking. Fileless malware exploits legitimate system or user processes while residing inside the memory. The continuous evolution of those attacks requires countermeasures that can adapt to rapid changes. Utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to detect fileless malware attacks creates security controls that continuously evolve to keep pace with the ever-changing nature of cyberattacks. This project aims to develop a desktop tool that uses artificial intelligence to detect fileless malware through analyzing memory snapshots. The main target is to create a deep learning model that detects malicious instructions residing in the device memory. The tool blocks the infected process and alerts the user to suspicious activity. Detection accuracy is compared against several machine learning algorithms to ensure tool efficiency. Other related metrics, such as the detection time and the ratio of utilizing system resources, are also considered in the performance analysis. The proposed detection tool represents a contribution to current applied solutions to counter modern cyber threats and participate in protecting the digital transformation process and securing the community.

title: Tabayn (تبیّن)
abstract: Smishing attacks continue to increase as a cybersecurity threat. There are many tools available to detect them, but the gap we want to fill is that most of them are not designed to consider the linguistic and cultural differences of non-English languages, leaving Arabic-speaking users more vulnerable. The need for smishing detection arises because such attacks cause significant financial and personal damage, while traditional tools typically fail to address the unique challenges of Arabic text messages. This project presents Tabayn, a mobile application developed to detect and prevent smishing in Arabic text messages. The importance of Tabayn lies in its ability to protect Arabic-speaking users from smishing attacks in their most dangerous forms. Tabayn leverages the latest Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques to provide accurate analysis and classification of text messages and identify malicious content. To enhance model performance, the project implemented the stacking method and ensemble learning. The base models used in the stacking method include Support Vector Machine (SVM) with a linear kernel, Random Forest (RF), and Gradient Boosting, creating a robust foundation for reliable detection. The meta model used for final classification is Logistic Regression. Additionally, a complete dataset of smishing text messages in Arabic was developed, collected through user surveys and enriched with AI-generated examples, ensuring linguistic authenticity and diversity. A waterfall methodology was employed, ensuring structured development from requirements gathering to system deployment. The goal of Tabayn is to provide users with a seamless way to upload messages for verification and receive immediate feedback, ultimately increasing their awareness of smishing tactics.

title: Mail Pawns: Advanced Email Malicious Detection System
abstract: This project addresses the increasing risk of malicious emails by creating a bilingual detection system designed to improve the safety via email. Mail Pawns aims to enhance detection especially in Arabic, which is an area that is frequently overlooked in current solutions. By allowing users to manually identify suspicious emails and take appropriate action, and equipping admins with monitoring tools, the system ensures a balance between usability and control. The solution was developed with a focus on critical needs, including the increasing frequency of email attacks, the importance of supporting Arabic language detection, and the desire to streamline user experience. Ultimately, this project advances the safety and reliability of communication platforms by applying intelligent design, machine learning techniques, and language-specific natural language

title: MUKHBIR: A Hybrid Framework for Detecting GAN-Generated Images
abstract: With AI-generated images becoming increasingly realistic, the challenge of detecting synthetic content is more critical than ever. Traditional detection methods often struggle to generalize across different generative models or lack transparency in how decisions are made. Mukhbir is a hybrid detection system designed to address this gap by combining gradient-based image transformation with a SwinV2-Large Transformer classifier. Tested on a balanced and high-quality dataset from seven different GANs, Mukhbir offers both strong accuracy and visual explainability, supporting real-world use in media verification and digital forensics.

title: BusMap
abstract: The BusMap mobile application is an innovative solution aimed at transforming public transportation through the integration of modern technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and real-time data tracking. The primary objective of the app is to enhance the efficiency, safety, and convenience of daily commuting for both passengers and transportation operators. Using AI algorithms, BusMap intelligently optimizes bus routes by arranging student or passenger stops in the most logical and time-efficient order based on proximity and traffic patterns. This ensures that bus drivers follow the fastest route possible while minimizing delays and fuel consumption. In addition to route optimization, the app provides real-time updates on bus locations, estimated arrival times, and any sudden changes or disruptions in the route. This transparency allows passengers to better plan their journeys and avoid long waiting times. For transportation operators and school supervisors, BusMap offers tools for performance tracking, shift scheduling, and attendance management, improving oversight and accountability across the system. By combining user-friendly design with cutting-edge backend logic, BusMap not only enhances the overall commuting experience but also contributes to smarter, greener urban transportation. The app ultimately aims to reduce operational costs, improve safety, and increase reliability for all stakeholders involved.

title: Impact of Time Constraint on Maintenance Performance KPI
abstract: The Vice Rectorate for Assets and Investment at Princess Nourah Bint Abdulrahman University is responsible for delivering maintenance and support services across various university facilities, in alignment with the institution’s broader goals. However, due to time-based and operational constraints, such as restricted access to campus areas during daily hours, crew performance is often misjudged using traditional Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that fail to account for these limitations. As a result, maintenance tickets may experience unavoidable delays, particularly those with lower priority, negatively impacting overall performance scores. This project investigates the relationship between time constraints and maintenance KPIs through structured interviews and research. It proposes a system that adapts performance measurements to reflect real-world conditions more accurately. The developed solution consists of three main components: a machine learning model that classifies tickets and assigns difficulty-based weights, a dynamic KPI calculation module that adjusts based on those weights, and an interactive dashboard that visualizes performance across multiple styles. By integrating AI-driven predictions with flexible KPI design, the system ensures more accurate, fair, and actionable evaluations of maintenance performance under constrained conditions.

title: AllWay
abstract: Urban mobility is essential in rapidly growing cities like Riyadh, where the need for accessible and sustainable transportation solutions is critical. This thesis focuses on the AllWay mobile application, designed to enhance walking, running, and hiking experiences in Riyadh by providing detailed route planning and user-centric features. Riyadh’s extensive urban landscape and reliance on motorized transportation present significant barriers for pedestrians and tourists seeking to explore the city on foot. Current navigation apps primarily cater to vehicular traffic, leaving non-motorized travelers underserved. The AllWay app addresses this gap by offering a platform tailored to walking, running, and hiking routes, integrating route customization, and information on nearby amenities and landmarks. Through user surveys and research, this study identifies key needs for accessible routes, personalized preferences, and social features. The app incorporates features such as difficulty level filtering, community feedback, and integration of local cultural sites, enhancing both physical activity and urban exploration. AllWay is aligned with Saudi Vision 2030’s goals of sustainable urban development and active mobility. The app’s design incorporates features to provide an intuitive user experience, promoting healthier lifestyles and sustainable tourism. The findings suggest that AllWay can significantly improve urban mobility in Riyadh, fostering active engagement among residents and visitors while supporting Riyadh's broader urban development goals. The application represents a critical step toward addressing the challenges of urban exploration and mobility, setting the stage for future innovations in route planning for non-motorized travelers.

title: ParkPro
abstract: ParkPro is about offering easy way reserving parking spots, solving congestion, reducing searching time for a parking space, which is the main issues that face university students and employees in Saudi Arabia. ParkPro's system is designed with the Agile methodology in mind for iterative development and continuous user feedback. It lets users search, reserve, and rate parking spots, and the key features are marking parked car location and real-time notifications when spots become available

title: Easy Picks
abstract: In a world increasingly reliant on online shopping, the need for applications that provide a seamless and convenient experience for users has become essential. This is where Easy Picks comes in—the app that combines advanced technology with an easy-to-use interface to offer you an outstanding shopping experience. You can easily search for products either by entering their names or by uploading an image of the desired item, as the app analyzes the image to provide accurate options. The app also includes a dedicated section for saving printed invoices and converting them into electronic format, making it easy to track your purchases and use these invoices in the recommendation system. The recommendation system is based on your preferences, ensuring that you receive suggestions tailored to your interests and needs. We believe in the importance of listening to our customers, which is why the app allows you to share your personal experiences and submit ratings, contributing to service improvement. Additionally, making it easier to find the perfect options within your budget. The Easy Picks app is not just a shopping tool; it is a comprehensive platform designed to provide a comfortable and efficient user experience.

title: AI-Powered Platform for Monitoring and Analyzing Consumer Sentiments in the Cosmetics Industry
abstract: This project aims to develop a user-friendly web platform tailored for the skincare and cosmetics industry, enabling comprehensive, data-driven insights. The platform includes an integrated search engine that allows users to find products using keywords or hashtags, connecting directly to a text-based social media platform, such as Twitter. The system is designed to gather and analyze tweets related to the searched products, performing sentiment analysis to provide users with an overall understanding of public sentiment. This analysis helps highlight customer opinions and trends that are critical for informed decision-making. To enrich user experience, the platform employs generative AI to generate concise textual summaries, showcasing the main sentiments and themes mentioned in social media discussions. This feature allows users to quickly capture the essence of public perception without needing to sift through numerous posts. The project also incorporates interactive visualization tools, presenting key sentiment data and analytics on a dashboard. This visual interface makes it easy for users to interpret data, supporting cosmetic marketing teams in tracking consumer feedback and conducting competitor analysis. By providing these insights in an accessible format, the platform empowers businesses to refine their marketing strategies and enhance product evaluation

title: Visualize
abstract: Visually impaired people have trouble navigating around, identifying objects, reading and translating texts, and accessing information. Current assistive technologies often cover different needs independently, so that users often rely on multiples of these tools in their daily lives, which may be inefficient and impossibly inconvenient. To solve this problem, we developed "Visualize", a mobile integrated application which leverages the recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP). Visualize brings together into one user-friendly app the most important features: navigation, object recognition, reading text aloud, text translation, and searching for information. Completely voice-activated, the app allows an intuitive user interface designed for the unique needs of visually impaired users. It features leading technologies like OCR in extracting text, AI-powered real-time object detection, and straightforward voice interaction. The application is designed to help users' communication with the outside environment, giving them more independence and confidence in everyday tasks. Offering one solution, Visualize is designed to fix this problem in existing assistive tools and offers an integrated unified tool, that is considered a practical solution that would add real value to the quality of life for people with impaired vision. This project represents a meaningful leap forward in assistive technologies.

title: Luminis
abstract: Cognitive systems are now essential tools that help in constructing and enhancing mind performances, in which people can usually apply in active intellect, critical thinking, and problem-solving. These systems have evolved from cognitive science and have moved from being static to becoming more responsive and adaptive. On this basis, Luminis is a web application that offers an intelligent and engaging approach for users to study and practice their intellectual skills by solving numerous and various different text-based puzzles. It has a clear and easy-to-use interface that offers feedback and tracks the user’s progress in order to have a constant and measurable development. Luminis provides a practical solution to the problems of the traditional cognitive training tools such as non-personalized approach, repetitive inputs, and lack of engagement, making cognitive development more available, effective, and fun. In the long run, Luminis wants to bring about long-term cognitive development through the use of interactive, goal-oriented, and feedback-based learning methods that are fully personalized to the user’s unique needs and evolving performance.

title: Nabeeh : Artificial Intelligence-Based System for Attention monitoring of students
abstract: A This project presents an AI-powered system designed to monitor and enhance student engage ment in classrooms through automated video analysis. By processing uploaded classroom recordings, the system detects and analyzes each student’s face frame-by-frame using two key components: Ef ficientNet, fine-tuned on two child-focused datasets for emotion recognition with an accuracy of 84%, and OpenFace for gaze tracking. The results of these components are then aggregated through the trained machine learning model SVM with an accuracy of 96% to predict the engagement of the frame using the outputs of both of the EfficientNet and OpenFace. The extracted engagement data is aggregated and visualized through insightful charts -includ ing pie charts for overall engagement distribution and smoothed line graphs for time- based attention trends. These visualizations are compiled into a downloadable PDF report, enabling teachers to re view class performance at a glance and identify when students tend to lose focus. The system also stores engagement summaries in a real-time database, allowing teachers and administrators to track progress across multiple sessions. By providing objective, data-driven feed back, this solution addresses major limitations of manual observation, such as subjectivity and lack of scalability. Designed with privacy, usability, and educational value in mind, this AI system bridges the gap between traditional classroom monitoring and modern, data-informed teaching strategies, making it especially effective for engaging younger learners.

title: راصد RASID | Road defect detection and classification
abstract: The maintenance of road infrastructure is important for ensuring safety and efficiency in transportation systems. Current manual inspection methods for detecting road defects, such as potholes, cracks, and manholes, are inefficient and lead to delayed responses . This project proposes RASID, a smartphone-based road defect detection and classification system specifically designed for Riyadh. Utilizing advanced technologies such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the YOLOv8 algorithm, the system automatically classifies road defects with high accuracy. The application integrates the Google Maps API to capture and report precise defect locations, enabling users to submit reports directly to the Maintenance team. By streamlining defect detection and reporting, RASID aims to enhance road safety, reduce accidents, reduce driver stress, and improve the overall maintenance process within the city of Riyadh.

title: Image Forgery Detection Website: ForgeFinder
abstract: As digital manipulation software became available and the spread of misinformation became widespread, authenticating the genuineness of digital images was an essential need across industries. Forged images in social media, journalism, and legal investigations falsify facts, frame public opinions, and discredit evidence. Preempting this growing issue, ForgeFinder was developed as a smart, real-time web application that identifies image forgery with high precision and speed. ForgeFinder uses a combination of forensic analysis tools, including Error Level Analysis (ELA), to look for inconsistencies in image compression levels—typically a sign of image manipulation. ForgeFinder preprocesses and analyzes uploaded images using optimized image processing pipelines, delivering real-time results to the user in a clean and responsive web interface. The user can view detailed visual feedback and save analysis history securely in a personalized dashboard. The platform is built using Python, Flask, HTML/CSS/JS, and MySQL, and the development and test environment is managed using tools like Anaconda, MAMP, and Mailtrap. The use of platforms like Kaggle enabled the team to try out different detection models and datasets efficiently without relying on local resources. With reliability and scalability in its concept, ForgeFinder is not only a technical endeavor but a pragmatic product with pragmatic uses. It is a beneficial instrument for people, professionals, and institutions to easily and precisely establish image authenticity. Future enhancements include upgrading the system into video analysis, deeper detection accuracy, and cloud deployment for broader accessibility.

title: Sappaq - سبّاق
abstract: The “Sappaq” project is an innovative technological solution developed to address the growing issue of traffic congestion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, particularly congestion caused by road accidents. Recognizing the delays and inefficiencies in handling traffic incidents, Sappaq leverages drone technology to provide rapid and accurate accident documentation. The system is integrated with Google Maps and works in coordination with the Najm accident reporting service. When an accident is reported through Najm, a drone is automatically dispatched to the scene using pre-programmed GPS coordinates. Upon arrival, the drone captures high-resolution images and video footage of the accident site from multiple angles. This real-time visual data is then transmitted to a centralized control center, where specialists can quickly assess the situation, determine responsibility, and begin the necessary procedures without waiting for manual on-site inspections. This approach not only speeds up the accident documentation process but also reduces the impact on traffic flow by minimizing the time vehicles spend at the scene. Furthermore, the use of drones enhances the accuracy of accident reports and ensures safer, contactless data collection. “Sappaq” is a prime example of how smart technology and automation can be harnessed to improve traffic management, emergency response, and overall urban mobility in modern cities.

title: Portfolio-Hub Faculty Portfolio Management System
abstract: Today, faculty portfolios are considered an indispensable tool for faculty members across academic institutions. They serve as dynamic repositories of professional accomplishments, encompassing academic qualifications, teaching experience, scientific research, and a wide range of skills. In response to this need, PortfolioHub has been proposed as a centralized platform designed specifically for faculty members to document their achievements and showcase their expertise to peers, administrators, and students. The fundamental objective of this project is to implement a comprehensive digital portfolio system that enables faculty members to efficiently manage and update their professional information, including academic credentials, teaching history, research contributions, publications, awards, and other relevant activities. The proposed system will not only streamline the creation and management of portfolios but also enhance accessibility, organization, and visibility. By providing an intuitive and user-friendly interface, PortfolioHub will allow faculty members to build well-structured portfolios, easily associate supporting evidence, and maintain an up-to-date, professional digital presence that reflects their academic journey.

title: AI Grading Application
abstract: Manual grading of essay-style questions presents significant challenges for educators, including time consumption, inconsistency, and subjectivity. To address these issues, we developed GradeGenius, an AI-powered application that integrates ChatGPT to assist teachers in grading student responses. This system enables educators to upload exam content, supporting materials, and student information, after which it automates the grading process and provides feedback. GradeGenius streamlines the assessment process while maintaining accuracy, fairness, and efficiency. The solution is especially suited for handling large volumes of assessments and offers statistical analysis to support data-driven teaching strategies. While not a replacement for human judgment, GradeGenius enhances the grading experience by reducing workload and improving feedback quality in modern educational environments.

title: خلها علينا ‘Khalaha Alyna’ – Event Management App
abstract: This project aims to develop Khalaha Alyna, a user-friendly mobile application for event planning and management, designed for users in Saudi Arabia. The app streamlines event organization with features like event creation, guest list management, invitation distribution, and vendor coordination. Using the Waterfall methodology, the project follows a structured process from requirement gathering to implementation. Today’s methods, such as manual planning or complex software, are time-consuming and prone to errors—especially when managing guest lists and schedules. Khalaha Alyna addresses these challenges by offering a simple, centralized solution for both personal and professional events. The application is designed for individuals, event planners, and small businesses who often struggle with limited access to efficient planning tools. By focusing on a clear and intuitive user interface, the app improves the user experience and minimizes the need for support. The goal is to simplify event management and replace disorganized, complex methods with a smooth and hassle-free planning process.

As a result, maintenance tickets may experience unavoidable delays, particularly those with lower priority, negatively impacting overall performance scores. This project investigates the relationship between time constraints and maintenance KPIs through structured interviews and research. It proposes a system that adapts performance measurements to reflect real-world conditions more accurately. The developed solution consists of three main components: a machine learning model that classifies tickets and assigns difficulty-based weights, a dynamic KPI calculation module that adjusts based on those weights, and an interactive dashboard that visualizes performance across multiple styles. By integrating AI-driven predictions with flexible KPI design, the system ensures more accurate, fair, and actionable evaluations of maintenance performance under constrained conditions.

title: SyncUp
abstract: Remote teamwork has revolutionized project implementation, offering a flexible and collaborative solution to modern workplace demands. However, the abundance of scattered applications for meetings, task management, and communication often cause inefficiencies and distraction. To address these challenges, we propose SyncUp, a unified platform that enables seamless project management and real-time collaboration. SyncUp allows users to create and manage projects, edit shared files collaboratively, leave notes, and track progress using intuitive visual indicators that highlight remaining time and tasks. Additionally, users can seek expert advice when needed, fostering a community-driven approach to problem-solving. The platform's design incorporates agile methodologies, ensuring iterative improvements based on user feedback and evaluations. By integrating these features, SyncUp aims to streamline remote teamwork, enhance productivity, and promote effective collaboration.

title: UniFix— Predictive Maintenance
abstract: Predictive maintenance is a modern approach to facility management that leverages artificial intelligence to anticipate equipment failures before they occur. In this project, we developed UniFix—an intelligent predictive maintenance component designed to be integrated with the University Agency for Facilities and Operations at Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University. The system applies unsupervised machine learning algorithms to historical maintenance records, enabling it to detect anomalous patterns and cluster assets based on failure behaviors. Without relying on sensor data or pre-labeled events, UniFix extracts insights directly from real operational records and generates interpretable predictions about the expected failure date of each asset. By identifying behavioral similarities among assets, the system enhances awareness of maintenance-related risks and supports proactive planning. UniFix was built with flexibility and scalability in mind, allowing it to evolve and integrate into broader maintenance platforms. This project demonstrates how artificial intelligence, when applied thoughtfully, can transform traditional maintenance practices into predictive, data-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and support strategic decision-making.

title: خلها علينا ‘Khalaha Alyna’ – Event Management App
abstract: This project aims to develop Khalaha Alyna, a user-friendly mobile application for event planning and management, designed for users in Saudi Arabia. The app streamlines event organization with features like event creation, guest list management, invitation distribution, and vendor coordination. Using the Waterfall methodology, the project follows a structured process from requirement gathering to implementation. Today’s methods, such as manual planning or complex software, are time-consuming and prone to errors—especially when managing guest lists and schedules. Khalaha Alyna addresses these challenges by offering a simple, centralized solution for both personal and professional events. The application is designed for individuals, event planners, and small businesses who often struggle with limited access to efficient planning tools. By focusing on a clear and intuitive user interface, the app improves the user experience and minimizes the need for support. The goal is to simplify event management and replace disorganized, complex methods with a smooth and hassle-free planning process.

title: AutoReview
abstract: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) currently relies on domain experts to manually review Summaries of Product Characteristics (SPCs) submitted by pharmaceutical companies. Manual comparisons between generic drugs and registered New Chemical Entities (NCEs) are time-consuming and prone to human error, potentially impacting the efficiency and reliability of regulatory decisions. This project present AutoReview, an AI-based system proposed to completely automate the SPC review process to alleviate these issues. The proposed system leverages transformer-based models in the automatic documentation of contextual comparison and data extraction. Our approach uses cosine similarity to calculate the semantic similarity between sections of the SPC. To improve transparency and interpretability, AutoReview utilizes the thresholds based highlighting approach aimed at greater transparency and interpretability, producing color-coded results that clearly mark sections as either compatible or incompatible. The framework acts in alignment with principles of explainable information retrieval. Reviewed by experts, AutoReview aims to outperform existing solutions in maintaining internal consistency, increasing automated workflows, and rationalizing regulatory analysis.

title: رَفد RafdSign: Audio-to-Sign Language Translator
abstract: Individuals with hearing impairments face significant challenges in communicating with others in their daily lives, even during simple interactions. These communication barriers can lead to social isolation and limit opportunities for education, employment, and everyday interactions. Our project aims to address this issue by developing a speech-to-sign language translation system. This system will convert spoken language into sign language, helping bridge the communication gap between deaf and hearing individuals. Currently, solutions that effectively handle sign language translation are limited due to the complexity of gestures, expressions, and context in sign languages, posing a significant barrier for those who rely on it for communication. By addressing this need, our project aims to provide a tool for individuals with hearing impairments, making everyday communication more accessible for everyone. Our solution leverages AI models to ensure accurate translation. The model first converts the audio signal to text. Then, the text is converted to gloss, and finally, the gloss is used to extract keypoints that are utilized to render the final video. Our system is tested against multiple state-of-the-art models using various evaluation metrics and across several datasets. Additionally, we will evaluate our model through a user study to capture aspects that cannot be assessed using quantitative evaluation metrics.

title: واصف Mobile Application for Deaf and Mute individuals. (WASIF)
abstract: Our System, Wasif, offers a communication application for deaf and mute individuals, we aim to develop cross-platform application that bridges these communication gaps by translating spoken language into sign language symbols and written text, while converting sign language gestures into audible speech. Wasif application analyzes hand and facial movements in real-time, ensuring accurate and efficient communication. Built using robust frameworks which is TensorFlow, and OpenCV, seeks to empower deaf and mute individuals to fully engage in all aspects of life, it is have been validated through rigorous testing with target user groups, ensuring that it meets the real-world needs.

title: Deep Learning Based Wound Classification And Treatments Suggestion
abstract: This project aims to develop an automated system for classifying wound types using deep learning techniques. The system relies on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to analyze wound images uploaded by patients or healthcare providers, identifying the wound type accurately and suggesting appropriate treatment recommendations. The motivation behind this work is to reduce reliance on manual wound assessment, which can vary depending on the experience of healthcare professionals, and to provide a fast, reliable, and accurate diagnostic tool. The system features a simple user interface that allows users to upload images. These images undergo preprocessing before being analyzed by the model, which outputs the predicted wound type along with corresponding treatment suggestions. The project addresses challenges such as variations in image quality and limited training data, aiming to improve classification accuracy and support better clinical decision-making. Additionally, the system has potential applications in telemedicine and digital healthcareservices, contributing to the advancement of remote medical care solutions.

title: Nabeeh : Artificial Intelligence-Based System for Attention monitoring of students
abstract: A This project presents an AI-powered system designed to monitor and enhance student engage ment in classrooms through automated video analysis. By processing uploaded classroom recordings, the system detects and analyzes each student’s face frame-by-frame using two key components: Ef ficientNet, fine-tuned on two child-focused datasets for emotion recognition with an accuracy of 84%, and OpenFace for gaze tracking. The results of these components are then aggregated through the trained machine learning model SVM with an accuracy of 96% to predict the engagement of the frame using the outputs of both of the EfficientNet and OpenFace. The extracted engagement data is aggregated and visualized through insightful charts -includ ing pie charts for overall engagement distribution and smoothed line graphs for time- based attention trends. These visualizations are compiled into a downloadable PDF report, enabling teachers to re view class performance at a glance and identify when students tend to lose focus. The system also stores engagement summaries in a real-time database, allowing teachers and administrators to track progress across multiple sessions. By providing objective, data-driven feed back, this solution addresses major limitations of manual observation, such as subjectivity and lack of scalability. Designed with privacy, usability, and educational value in mind, this AI system bridges the gap between traditional classroom monitoring and modern, data-informed teaching strategies, making it especially effective for engaging younger learners.

title: 20-EIGHT: Website for Arabic language learning
abstract: Technology has inspired us and facilitated many difficulties in learning new skills. As a result, learning new language websites must adapt technological advancements to provide compatible websites, especially in Arabic, due to a lack of sufficient resources. We have noticed that finding resources for learning the Arabic language easily and at any time requires the development of smart websites. This project aims to help learners worldwide get a comprehensive and attractive educational experience in the Arabic language. The website will contain different user roles, including learner, teacher, and administrator with a user-friendly interface and robust functions. Sufficient types of courses are available to support a wide range of learners, from beginners to advanced. The website will allow learners to view and book available slots based on teacher schedules. By providing a connection between learners and efficient teachers through scheduled live lessons the website will be a powerful tool for learners looking to improve their speaking skills. Also, the integration of AI assists learners in doing their homework and provides instant corrections. This project will be implemented using Django back-end, and React.js front-end. As a result, learners will be able to improve their Arabic skills by accessing the website at any time to learn and practice, ensuring continuous learning.

title: Luminis
abstract: Cognitive systems are now essential tools that help in constructing and enhancing mind performances, in which people can usually apply in active intellect, critical thinking, and problem-solving. These systems have evolved from cognitive science and have moved from being static to becoming more responsive and adaptive. On this basis, Luminis is a web application that offers an intelligent and engaging approach for users to study and practice their intellectual skills by solving numerous and various different text-based puzzles. It has a clear and easy-to-use interface that offers feedback and tracks the user’s progress in order to have a constant and measurable development. Luminis provides a practical solution to the problems of the traditional cognitive training tools such as non-personalized approach, repetitive inputs, and lack of engagement, making cognitive development more available, effective, and fun. In the long run, Luminis wants to bring about long-term cognitive development through the use of interactive, goal-oriented, and feedback-based learning methods that are fully personalized to the user’s unique needs and evolving performance.

title: Collab: A Revolutionary web-based platform designed for collaborative coding projects
abstract: Collab is a web-based platform developed to transform collaborative coding by addressing key challenges such as poor communication, version control issues, and fragmented workflows. It provides two core features that enhance productivity and teamwork. The first is real-time simultaneous coding, which allows multiple users to write, review, and edit code together in a shared environment. The second is integrated project management, offering drag-and-drop UML diagramming, task distribution, and progress tracking tools—all within the same workspace. Designed especially for academic and educational settings, Collab streamlines the collaborative process by combining technical development with visual project planning. Its intuitive interface supports various programming languages and tools, ensuring accessibility for students, instructors, and development teams alike. With full browser-based access and support for remote collaboration, Collab is built for modern, global use. It empowers users to manage projects efficiently, foster innovation, and improve outcomes in coding-based coursework, capstone projects, and real-world software development practice.

title: Dexter
abstract: With artificial intelligence becoming increasingly accessible, distinguishing between human-written and AI-generated text has become more challenging. A lot of people nowadays rely on AI to generate content for everyday tasks, including expressing personal thoughts and feelings. This increasing reliance may result in issues like spam, false information, and misleading content. This graduation project introduces “Dexter”, an AI detection tool developed to detect a text that is produced by an AI and promote transparency in digital communication. Dexter enables users to input any text and uses advanced algorithms to analyze and determine whether the content is human-written or AI-generated. The system presents results clearly, displaying percentages and visually highlighting the segments most likely written by an ai. It also provides visual analysis through a pie chart, offering users intuitive and immediate feedback. Ultimately, Dexter’s mission is to empower users to recognize and differentiate between authentic human expression and AI-generated content, fostering trust and authenticity in digital interactions.

title: Tabayn (تبیّن)
abstract: Smishing attacks continue to increase as a cybersecurity threat. There are many tools available to detect them, but the gap we want to fill is that most of them are not designed to consider the linguistic and cultural differences of non-English languages, leaving Arabic-speaking users more vulnerable. The need for smishing detection arises because such attacks cause significant financial and personal damage, while traditional tools typically fail to address the unique challenges of Arabic text messages. This project presents Tabayn, a mobile application developed to detect and prevent smishing in Arabic text messages. The importance of Tabayn lies in its ability to protect Arabic-speaking users from smishing attacks in their most dangerous forms. Tabayn leverages the latest Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques to provide accurate analysis and classification of text messages and identify malicious content. To enhance model performance, the project implemented the stacking method and ensemble learning. The base models used in the stacking method include Support Vector Machine (SVM) with a linear kernel, Random Forest (RF), and Gradient Boosting, creating a robust foundation for reliable detection. The meta model used for final classification is Logistic Regression. Additionally, a complete dataset of smishing text messages in Arabic was developed, collected through user surveys and enriched with AI-generated examples, ensuring linguistic authenticity and diversity. A waterfall methodology was employed, ensuring structured development from requirements gathering to system deployment. The goal of Tabayn is to provide users with a seamless way to upload messages for verification and receive immediate feedback, ultimately increasing their awareness of smishing tactics.

title: TOWARDS A WORLD WITHOUT PHYSICAL IDs: Face Anti-Spoof Recognition System for The Nourah Students Application.
abstract: This project presents a robust and real-time face anti-spoofing authentication system developed for the Nourah Students application, addressing the growing security concerns in biometric verification. The proposed solution enhances the reliability of facial analysis through deep learning-based methods tailored for student identity verification. The system integrates two key components: a facial recognition module utilizing FaceNet and a spoof detection module based on the EfficientNet-B0 architecture. To improve the model's resilience against both physical and digital spoofing attacks, two data augmentation strategies-Simulated Physical Spoofing Clues (SPSC) and Simulated Digital Spoofing Clues (SDSC)-were applied during training on the LCC-FASD dataset. The model was evaluated using three distinct protocols (pl, p2.1, p2.2), simulating a variety of spoofing scenarios and demonstrating high performance, with accuracy reaching up to 94.3% and strong generalization capabilities. Despite being developed and tested under limited computational resources, the system achieved low false acceptance and rejection rates, confirming its suitability for real-time deployment. Compared to contemporary methods, this approach offers an effective balance of accuracy, efficiency, and security, making it a viable solution for integration into various applications that require trustworthy facial authentication.

title: سند SANAD : Proactive Defense for Individuals with Bipolar Disorder Through a Personlized Cyber Protection
abstract: Bipolar disorder (BD) affects approximately 40 million individuals globally, including over 320,000 in Saudi Arabia. This condition is characterized by manic and depressive episodes, which drive impulsive behaviors such as poor decision-making and risk-taking. These behaviors expose BD patients to significant cybersecurity threats, including phishing, privacy breaches, and unauthorized financial activities. This research explores tailored cybersecurity interventions to effectively mitigate online risks for individuals with BD. Despite advancements in cybersecurity, the unique vulnerabilities of BD patients remain underexplored, with limited integration of behavioral analytics in current solutions. Existing systems fail to account for the dynamic and unpredictable behaviors associated with mood episodes, creating a gap in behavioral cybersecurity practices. Addressing this gap is essential for protecting this vulnerable population and advancing the field of cybersecurity. This study proposes Sanad, an advanced cybersecurity solution tailored to BD patients. The system leverages keystroke dynamics to monitor behavioral patterns, detect mood shifts, and implement adaptive protective measures. Core features include application and web access restrictions, financial transaction controls, adaptive trusted-contact management, and real-time monitoring mechanisms to safeguard sensitive information, ensuring that users’ privacy remains uncompromised during high-risk episodes. These measures are designed to mitigate impulsive online actions, safeguard sensitive information, and enhance user autonomy. By bridging the gap between mental health and cybersecurity, this research aligns with the Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority’s (NCA) strategic objectives to enhance behavioral cybersecurity. This research aims to establish Sanad as a pioneering solution that protects high-risk populations and contributes to the development of innovative cybersecurity practices.

title: Mail Pawns: Advanced Email Malicious Detection System
abstract: This project addresses the increasing risk of malicious emails by creating a bilingual detection system designed to improve the safety via email. Mail Pawns aims to enhance detection especially in Arabic, which is an area that is frequently overlooked in current solutions. By allowing users to manually identify suspicious emails and take appropriate action, and equipping admins with monitoring tools, the system ensures a balance between usability and control. The solution was developed with a focus on critical needs, including the increasing frequency of email attacks, the importance of supporting Arabic language detection, and the desire to streamline user experience. Ultimately, this project advances the safety and reliability of communication platforms by applying intelligent design, machine learning techniques, and language-specific natural language

title: سد Real-Time Vishing Detection and Call Analysis System Using NLP and AI
abstract: In an era where cyber threats are becoming increasingly sophisticated, "سَــد" emerges as an innovative solution to combat voice phishing (vishing) attacks, with a special focus on Arabic-speaking users. This intelligent detection system integrates Speech-to-Text (STT), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and a fine-tuned BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model to analyze incoming calls in real time. By accurately converting spoken Arabic into written text, سَـــد detects suspicious or deceptive language patterns that indicate potential social engineering attempts. The system immediately alerts users to the risk, allowing them to make informed decisions before falling victim to scams. What sets سَـــد apart is its deep linguistic understanding of Arabic, a language known for its richness and complexity, making it highly effective in regional contexts. سَـــد not only provides reliable, real-time protection, but also raises awareness and builds user confidence in dealing with fraudulent calls. This project represents a major step forward in Arabic-language cybersecurity.

title: Children’s Educational Application Battoot
abstract: This project introduces Battoot, an AI-powered educational application designed to support early Arabic literacy among children aged 4 to 8. The application aims to bridge the gap in digital Arabic learning tools by focusing on two essential skills: handwriting and pronunciation. Battoot integrates a fine-tuned Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for Arabic Handwriting Recognition (HWR) and a pre-trained transformer-based model for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). The system provides real-time, constructive feedback to learners, enhancing engagement through gamified elements and a child-friendly interface. A robust client-server architecture ensures efficient processing, while model performance is validated through extensive fine-tuning and testing on child-specific datasets such as Hijja and Dhad. The result is an innovative educational application that not only improves children’s recognition and production of Arabic letters but also sets a foundation for further language development. By combining deep learning, thoughtful design, and interactive learning principles, Battoot contributes a novel solution to early childhood Arabic education.

title: RASAD - An AI-Powered Safety Detection System for Monitoring and Ensuring Compliance in Restaurants and Kitchens
abstract: The food service industry continues to face significant challenges in maintaining hygiene standards, primarily due to reliance on outdated and labor-intensive manual monitoring practices, which increase the risk of health violations. In Saudi Arabia, recent reports indicate that over 50% of foodborne illness cases are directly attributable to safety non-compliance within restaurants [Source needed]. This project introduces Rasad, an intelligent, automated system designed to monitor and enforce food safety compliance through computer vision and machine learning techniques. The development of Rasad followed a structured machine learning pipeline, beginning with rigorous image preprocessing to enhance model robustness and accuracy. Several state-of-the-art object detection algorithms were systematically evaluated, including Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN), You only Look version 5 (YOLOv5), YOLOv8, and the emerging YOLOv11. Experimental results demonstrated that YOLOv11 outperformed its counterparts, achieving a mean Average Precision at 50% IoU (mAP50) of 86.7% in detecting common hygiene violations, such as the absence of gloves, masks, or hairnets in restaurant kitchen environments. The optimized YOLOv11 model was integrated into a user-friendly web application built with Streamlit, enabling real-time analysis of image and video feeds from surveillance cameras. By automating the detection of safety breaches, the Rasad system offers a proactive solution to mitigate hygiene violations at their source. Beyond its technical contributions, Rasad holds the potential to significantly enhance public health outcomes, reduce the regulatory burden on health authorities, and promote a culture of accountability and safety in Saudi Arabia’s food service sector.

title: عَون AWN Volunteer management website
abstract: Volunteering is the act of individuals offering their time, skills, and resources to benefit others without financial compensation, enhancing the cohesion and progress of society. To support this field, we are developing an intermediary website that connects volunteer organizations with volunteers, making it easier for them to collaborate effectively. Our website simplifies volunteer program management by helping volunteers or guests track attendance, record and calculate volunteer hours, and view detailed program plans. Supervisors can assign specific tasks and responsibilities, while progress reports are automatically sent to all parties involved to ensure transparency and accountability. Additionally, certificates are automatically issued to volunteers, personalized with their names and achievements, and electronically signed by the supervisor. This solution will streamline the volunteer experience, making it more efficient and rewarding for both volunteers and organizations.

title: Driver drowsiness detection system
abstract: Drowsy driving is one of the major causes of road accidents, especially on long highways and during night travel. Many drivers are unaware that they are sleepy until it is too late. This project aims to solve that problem by developing a real-time drowsiness detection system using a smart camera (Nicla Vision) and a lightweight AI model. The system monitors the driver’s face and checks if their eyes are closed. If the eyes stay closed for more than three seconds, a buzzer sounds to alert the driver. We trained a custom machine learning model using images of eyes labeled as “Drowsy” and “Not Drowsy” through Edge Impulse. The model was then deployed to the Nicla Vision board, allowing it to run completely offline and in real time. The use of a small embedded device ensures low cost, energy efficiency, and easy installation in any vehicle. The prototype was tested under controlled conditions and successfully detected signs of drowsiness with 95% accuracy. This solution is practical, affordable. It highlights how AI and embedded systems can improve public safety. By alerting drowsy drivers early, the system helps reduce accident risks and contributes to building safer roads.

title: صائب Drone detection in Dual Vision Modalities Using YOLO Models and SAHI Framework
abstract: In line with Saudi Arabia’s strategic goal to localize 50% of its total government defense spending and achieve military self-sufficiency by 2030, this project delivers a cutting-edge solution to one of today’s most pressing and rapidly evolving security challenges: drone detection. We introduce a real-time drone monitoring system that fuses infrared (IR) and RGB imaging with advanced YOLOv11 object detection models, further optimized through the Slicing Aided Hyper Inference (SAHI) framework for improved small-object recognition. The system is engineered to detect small, fast-moving, and distant drones operating under complex and unpredictable real-world conditions, including variable lighting and background noise. This is achieved through a dual-model architecture that strategically balances inference speed, detection precision, and operational reliability. With scalability and adaptability at its core, the proposed solution significantly enhances situational awareness, early threat identification, and rapid response capabilities. It also contributes meaningfully to the expanding ecosystem of sovereign, locally developed defense technologies.

title: Image Forgery Detection Website: ForgeFinder
abstract: As digital manipulation software became available and the spread of misinformation became widespread, authenticating the genuineness of digital images was an essential need across industries. Forged images in social media, journalism, and legal investigations falsify facts, frame public opinions, and discredit evidence. Preempting this growing issue, ForgeFinder was developed as a smart, real-time web application that identifies image forgery with high precision and speed. ForgeFinder uses a combination of forensic analysis tools, including Error Level Analysis (ELA), to look for inconsistencies in image compression levels—typically a sign of image manipulation. ForgeFinder preprocesses and analyzes uploaded images using optimized image processing pipelines, delivering real-time results to the user in a clean and responsive web interface. The user can view detailed visual feedback and save analysis history securely in a personalized dashboard. The platform is built using Python, Flask, HTML/CSS/JS, and MySQL, and the development and test environment is managed using tools like Anaconda, MAMP, and Mailtrap. The use of platforms like Kaggle enabled the team to try out different detection models and datasets efficiently without relying on local resources. With reliability and scalability in its concept, ForgeFinder is not only a technical endeavor but a pragmatic product with pragmatic uses. It is a beneficial instrument for people, professionals, and institutions to easily and precisely establish image authenticity. Future enhancements include upgrading the system into video analysis, deeper detection accuracy, and cloud deployment for broader accessibility.

title: دال AI behavioural analysis for academic decision making (DALL)
abstract: Choosing the right college major is a critical decision for high school students, as it significantly influences their academic and professional future. However, many students struggle with this decision due to a lack of personalized guidance and an overwhelming number of options. This project proposes a solution to address these challenges by developing a Major Guidance Test system that combines GPA-based eligibility analysis and interest-matching to provide tailored recommendations. The system incorporates key features such as a GPA calculator, which computes the student’s academic standing based on school grades and standardized test scores. This GPA is then used as an essential input for the model, ensuring that the recommendations are both realistic and achievable. Additionally, the platform includes an interactive chatbot to assist students by answering questions about majors, eligibility requirements, and career paths. By integrating these tools, the system aims to empower students with personalized recommendations that align with their strengths, preferences, and academic qualifications. This solution not only reduces uncertainty but also helps students confidently choose a major that sets them on a successful academic and career path. The platform has the potential to transform how students approach one of the most important decisions in their educational journey.

title: Nabeeh : Artificial Intelligence-Based System for Attention monitoring of students
abstract: A This project presents an AI-powered system designed to monitor and enhance student engage ment in classrooms through automated video analysis. By processing uploaded classroom recordings, the system detects and analyzes each student’s face frame-by-frame using two key components: Ef ficientNet, fine-tuned on two child-focused datasets for emotion recognition with an accuracy of 84%, and OpenFace for gaze tracking. The results of these components are then aggregated through the trained machine learning model SVM with an accuracy of 96% to predict the engagement of the frame using the outputs of both of the EfficientNet and OpenFace. The extracted engagement data is aggregated and visualized through insightful charts -includ ing pie charts for overall engagement distribution and smoothed line graphs for time- based attention trends. These visualizations are compiled into a downloadable PDF report, enabling teachers to re view class performance at a glance and identify when students tend to lose focus. The system also stores engagement summaries in a real-time database, allowing teachers and administrators to track progress across multiple sessions. By providing objective, data-driven feed back, this solution addresses major limitations of manual observation, such as subjectivity and lack of scalability. Designed with privacy, usability, and educational value in mind, this AI system bridges the gap between traditional classroom monitoring and modern, data-informed teaching strategies, making it especially effective for engaging younger learners.

title: علامة CourseAssist: CLO Performance Assistant “E-CPA”
abstract: The rapid evolution of educational technology necessitates innovative approaches to enhance the assessment of student performance and course effectiveness. Our project addresses a significant issue present when faculty members spend an excessive amount of time completing the necessary documentation to achieve course objectives. To tackle this problem, we developed "Alama," an automated mobile application that streamlines the traditional Excel data entry process. This application calculates Course Learning Outcomes (CLOs) and Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs) automatically, generating performance reports in moments rather than relying on manual entry. Alama not only mitigates the inefficiencies of conventional assessment methods, which can lead to inaccuracies and impede effective decision-making, but also integrates both quantitative and qualitative data. This holistic approach enhances the evaluation of educational processes, ultimately improving the learning experience for students. In conclusion, the implementation of Alama presents a significant advancement in academic assessment, offering both advantages—such as time savings and enhanced accuracy—and potential drawbacks, including the initial learning curve for faculty. Overall, Alama holds the promise of transforming educational assessment practices, leading to better educational outcomes.

title: Analysis of Ancient Rock Inscriptions in Saudi Arabia Using Machine Learning
abstract: Saudi Arabia is home to numerous archaeological sites featuring ancient rock inscriptions, many dating back thousands of years. These inscriptions offer invaluable insights into the region’s historical, cultural, and linguistic heritage. They serve as a crucial link in understanding the evolution of the Arabic language and its integration into the broader context of the Arabian Peninsula. Despite their significance, this rich archaeological record remains relatively underexplored, particularly in relation to the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Aligned with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 objectives to preserve and promote cultural heritage, this project presents Thamad. This innovative application employs AI techniques to detect and translate Thamudic inscriptions into Arabic. Developed in collaboration with the Heritage Commission, the system utilizes annotated image data processed through object detection and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) models to locate inscriptions and recognize individual characters photographed by users. In addition to its translation capabilities, Thamad provides an interactive platform for language learning through educational games, encouraging broader public engagement with the ancient script. By integrating advanced technological tools with domain-specific knowledge, this project contributes to cultural preservation while enabling a deeper understanding of Saudi Arabia’s archaeological legacy.

title: AutoReview
abstract: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) currently relies on domain experts to manually review Summaries of Product Characteristics (SPCs) submitted by pharmaceutical companies. Manual comparisons between generic drugs and registered New Chemical Entities (NCEs) are time-consuming and prone to human error, potentially impacting the efficiency and reliability of regulatory decisions. This project present AutoReview, an AI-based system proposed to completely automate the SPC review process to alleviate these issues. The proposed system leverages transformer-based models in the automatic documentation of contextual comparison and data extraction. Our approach uses cosine similarity to calculate the semantic similarity between sections of the SPC. To improve transparency and interpretability, AutoReview utilizes the thresholds based highlighting approach aimed at greater transparency and interpretability, producing color-coded results that clearly mark sections as either compatible or incompatible. The framework acts in alignment with principles of explainable information retrieval. Reviewed by experts, AutoReview aims to outperform existing solutions in maintaining internal consistency, increasing automated workflows, and rationalizing regulatory analysis.

title: Dexter
abstract: With artificial intelligence becoming increasingly accessible, distinguishing between human-written and AI-generated text has become more challenging. A lot of people nowadays rely on AI to generate content for everyday tasks, including expressing personal thoughts and feelings. This increasing reliance may result in issues like spam, false information, and misleading content. This graduation project introduces “Dexter”, an AI detection tool developed to detect a text that is produced by an AI and promote transparency in digital communication. Dexter enables users to input any text and uses advanced algorithms to analyze and determine whether the content is human-written or AI-generated. The system presents results clearly, displaying percentages and visually highlighting the segments most likely written by an ai. It also provides visual analysis through a pie chart, offering users intuitive and immediate feedback. Ultimately, Dexter’s mission is to empower users to recognize and differentiate between authentic human expression and AI-generated content, fostering trust and authenticity in digital interactions.

title: SyncUp
abstract: Remote teamwork has revolutionized project implementation, offering a flexible and collaborative solution to modern workplace demands. However, the abundance of scattered applications for meetings, task management, and communication often cause inefficiencies and distraction. To address these challenges, we propose SyncUp, a unified platform that enables seamless project management and real-time collaboration. The platform's design incorporates agile methodologies, ensuring iterative improvements based on user feedback and evaluations. By integrating these features, SyncUp aims to streamline remote teamwork, enhance productivity, and promote effective collaboration.
